description: This file is a React component (App.tsx) implementing a sophisticated front-end for a Persona Builder application. It manages document uploads, workflow states, persona data editing, version history, and communicates with backend APIs for orchestration, persona updates, and versioning. The component renders a multi-step UI with dynamic content based on user interactions and backend responses.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Converts backend JSON data into the UI's PersonaData format, providing fallback defaults.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file selection via input or drag-and-drop, validates files, and updates upload state.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds new files to upload list after validation, respecting maximum count limit.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the upload list by its ID.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates the persona build process by uploading documents and triggering orchestration. Handles backend responses and polling for progress.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data as a new version to the backend.

methods.name: refreshVersions
methods.description: Loads the persona version history from the backend.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles profile image upload, creating object URL, and updating persona data.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes an experience entry from the persona data.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skill list.
